title: Warehouse access
description: Bind users to warehouses and control their order, intake and return access.
unbound: No warehouse bound · no data access
noWarehouses: No warehouses available. Create a warehouse in Locations & Shipping first.
selfHelp: You cannot change your own access here. Ask another platform administrator.
menuHelp: Warehouse users see Orders and Device intake & dispatch → Intake / Returned. Product and SKU definitions are shared; warehouse data stays within their assigned scope.
sessionHelp: Warehouse restrictions apply to subsequent requests. Menu permissions refresh automatically; sign in again after a role change to refresh native permissions.

help.platform: Full platform access, including all warehouses and permission settings.
help.all: Access orders, intake, returns and allocation across all warehouses. Platform settings remain restricted.
help.bound: Only see and operate on fulfillment orders, devices and stock in the warehouses selected below.

errors.request: Could not load or save warehouse access. Please retry.
errors.denied: Only a platform administrator can manage warehouse access.
errors.self: You cannot change your own access.
errors.locationsInvalid: A selected warehouse no longer exists. Refresh and select again.
errors.supplier: Supplier accounts use their separate supplier access settings.
errors.roleMissing: The warehouse role has not been initialized. Contact a platform administrator.
